Would you approve the following exceptions to the copying and disclosure restrictions for this unfinished cut?

- **Review access.** Four festival programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer may view the cut under written confidentiality obligations. We propose individual streaming access for three viewers and one offline screener each for the other two. Each offline copy would stay on encrypted equipment and be deleted when review ends. No viewer may forward a screener or make further copies.
- **Selection board.** A programmer may give the board a short oral synopsis in a confidential selection meeting. If you prefer to approve the wording, we can submit the synopsis in advance. The board would receive no screener, clips, or stills.
- **Backup.** We would revoke viewing access when review ends. The platform retains a backup for 30 days after removal of the active screener. We need your approval for that retention period. If it is unacceptable, we would need to agree on another delivery method before upload.
- **Catalog.** If selected, the festival may draft and circulate a text-only entry among the staff preparing the catalog under confidentiality. We can send you the entry for factual review. We request permission to publish it at or after the festival’s official selection announcement, even if the film’s public release comes later. Until the announcement, the draft stays internal. Use of clips, stills, or quotations would require separate approval.

Please confirm which terms you approve and identify any changes you need before we receive the cut.

We accept the overall review and catalog structure, subject to the controls below. The draft’s no-copying/no-disclosure rule stays in force until public release; the exceptions below are review-only and do not change that baseline.

**1. Review access – approved with conditions**
- Named reviewers plus written confidentiality obligations are acceptable. Please provide the list of names and their affiliations before access is issued.
- Watermarking is mandatory on every stream and on the offline screener. Watermarks should be viewer-specific and persistent across any permitted pause/snapshot functionality. If the platform cannot watermark offline files, we will require an alternative equivalent control.
- Offline screener: acceptable on encrypted equipment, with strict no-forwarding/no-copying terms. We require a signed deletion record from the festival contact confirming destruction of the file and any temporary renders/cache at the end of review. The record should be returned within one business day of review completion.

**2. Selection board – approved with conditions**
- Oral synopsis is acceptable only after we approve the wording. Please submit the proposed text for factual and secrecy review. We will clear or redline within two business days.
- The synopsis must not reference the ending or the cast cameo. If the board meeting format risks extemporaneous detail, we need the approved wording read verbatim or distributed as the approved one-pager only.
- No screener, clips, or stills to the board: accepted.

**3. Backup – not approved as proposed; proposed alternative**
- A 30-day platform retention after active screener removal creates uncertainty for sudden withdrawal and for secrecy. We cannot consent to an open retention window of that length for an unfinished cut.
- Tradeoff: we will permit a short technical buffer only if the backup is watermarked, access-locked to named reviewers, and immediately purgeable on our instruction. If the platform must retain anything, the retention must end at the earlier of (a) our withdrawal instruction, (b) public release, or (c) a fixed short window of no more than 7 days after the active screener is removed. The backup must not be used for any secondary review, clip extraction, or internal circulation.
- If that is unacceptable to your platform, we will need a different delivery method before upload (for example, a one-time encrypted transfer with immediate deletion confirmation and no persistent platform copy). Please confirm which path you prefer.

**4. Catalog – approved with conditions**
- Text-only drafting and internal circulation under confidentiality are acceptable. Please route the draft to us for factual review; we will clear or redline within two business days.
- Publication at or after the festival’s official selection announcement is acceptable only after we sign off on the text. Publication is not automatic at announcement; we retain approval rights over any publicity excerpt, including catalog text, until the film’s public release embargo lifts.
- No clips, stills, or quotations in the catalog without separate approval: accepted. The catalog text must remain free of ending and cameo details.

**5. Embargo trigger and sudden withdrawal**
- We need a defined withdrawal path. Upon our written notice (email to the designated festival contacts), the festival must:
  - Revoke streaming access immediately and confirm revocation within the same business day.
  - Secure the offline screener and complete deletion per the deletion record, confirming completion within one business day.
  - Halt further circulation of the synopsis and catalog draft, and pause any public-facing use until we confirm in writing.
  - Instruct the platform to purge or lock the backup per the backup terms above and confirm completion.
- If a technical or logistical delay makes immediate revocation impossible, the festival must notify us at once and place the cut in a hold state with no viewer access until the issue is resolved. We reserve the right to withdraw the cut at any time without prior notice; the festival’s obligations above apply regardless of reason.

**6. Turnaround and approvals**
- We can clear draft copy and approved wording within two business days. Please factor that into your selection meeting schedule and catalog production timeline.
- All publicity excerpts, including the catalog entry, require our prior approval. No excerpt may be adapted, paraphrased, or expanded publicly without our sign-off.
- Any request to add reviewers, change delivery methods, or extend retention must come back to us for approval before implementation.

**Before we receive the cut, please confirm:**
- The watermarking standard for streaming and offline copies.
- The deletion record format and who signs it.
- The backup handling you can support (short purgeable window vs. alternative delivery).
- That the proposed synopsis and catalog text will be submitted to us for approval and that neither will disclose the ending or cameo.
- The designated festival contacts for withdrawal notices and deletion confirmation.

Once those are locked, we will clear the review materials and proceed with delivery under the terms above.

We propose using a different delivery method. Our usual platform retains a backup for 30 days, so we will keep the cut off that platform. Would you approve three individual streams on a service you control and two one-time encrypted transfers, one to each designated offline reviewer? This would authorize exactly two offline copies, one per encrypted device. We would verify before delivery that the transfer service can erase each transfer copy on receipt, retain no backup, and purge an unclaimed transfer immediately on withdrawal.

**Access and watermarking.** Before anyone receives access, we will send the names and affiliations of the four programmers and the outside accessibility reviewer, identify the two offline recipients, and confirm that all five have signed confidentiality, no-forwarding, and no-further-copying terms. Each stream must display the viewer’s name throughout playback, including when paused and in any snapshot. Each offline file must have the recipient’s name burned into every frame. If either delivery route cannot meet that standard, we will seek your written approval for an equivalent control before using it.

**Deletion and withdrawal.** Each offline reviewer will confirm deletion of their file, temporary renders, and caches. The festival’s designated screening coordinator will sign a single record identifying both recipients, their devices by identifier, what each deleted, and when. We will return it within one business day of review completion or withdrawal.

We accept withdrawal at any time by email, for any reason. We propose the head of programming and the screening coordinator as the two notice contacts, with the coordinator responsible for deletion confirmation. We will supply their names and direct email addresses before delivery. On notice, we will immediately stop viewing, secure both offline devices, halt circulation of the synopsis and catalog draft, and pause public use pending your written clearance. For streams you host, we propose that your administrator disable all three accounts immediately, with the festival confirming revocation to you the same business day after verification. We will request immediate purge of any pending transfers and confirm completion. If revocation is delayed, we will alert you at once and coordinate an immediate access hold.

**Board and catalog.** We will submit the short synopsis for written approval and have a programmer read the cleared wording verbatim in the confidential board meeting. The board will receive no copy or footage. If selected, we may draft the text-only catalog entry and circulate it confidentially to the staff preparing it. Both texts will omit the ending and cameo. We will allow two business days for each review and wait for express written clearance. Catalog publication may begin only once you have signed off on the exact text and the festival has announced the selection. Any other publicity excerpt, public rewording, clip, still, or quotation requires separate written approval.

Please confirm the split delivery method, the two offline copies, and who on your side can disable the streams immediately. Delivery remains pending that approval, verification of the technical controls, and exchange of the reviewer and contact details. Any later change to reviewers, delivery, or retention will come back to you for prior approval.

We accept the split delivery and the two offline copies in principle, subject to the technical confirmations, contact exchange, and control details below. Nothing here changes the baseline restriction on copying or disclosure before public release; the approvals are review-only and conditioned on the safeguards you listed.

**1. Delivery split and offline copies**
- Three individual streams on a service you control and two one-time encrypted transfers to the designated offline reviewers are acceptable, provided the technical controls below are verified in writing before delivery.
- Exactly two offline copies, one per encrypted device, is acceptable. Each file must carry the recipient’s name burned into every frame. If either route cannot meet the watermarking standard, we require your written request for an equivalent control and our prior approval before use.

**2. Watermarking and technical verification**
- Streaming: viewer name displayed throughout playback, including pause and any snapshot capability. We need written confirmation from the streaming service that this is enforced and cannot be disabled by the viewer.
- Offline: recipient name burned into every frame. We need written confirmation of the burning method and that the file cannot be played in a player that strips or obscures the watermark.
- Transfer service: we require written confirmation that each transfer is erased on receipt, that the service retains no backup copy, and that any unclaimed transfer is purged immediately on our withdrawal instruction. If the service cannot certify all three points, we will not use it and will require an alternative delivery method agreed in advance.

**3. Deletion record**
- The single coordinated record from the screening coordinator is acceptable. Please use a template that captures: the two recipients and their names/affiliations; device identifiers; the exact file version delivered to each; deletion method; disposal of temporary renders and caches; and timestamps for each deletion, signed by the coordinator and returned within one business day of review completion or withdrawal.
- If a recipient cannot complete deletion within that window, we need immediate notice and a remediation plan; the cut remains under withdrawal hold until we confirm completion.

**4. Backup and retention**
- Your proposed no-retention transfer path resolves the earlier 30-day backup concern. We approve that path only after the written certification above.
- For the three streams you host, we require confirmation that the service retains no content copies, re-encodes, or persistent backups beyond the active viewing session, and that withdrawal triggers immediate account disablement plus purge of any pending or cached transfer artifacts. If the service keeps technical access logs only (no content), that is acceptable. If any content residue is possible, we need a purge confirmation step on withdrawal.

**5. Withdrawal authority and contacts**
- Withdrawal by email at any time, for any reason, is accepted. We will address notice to the head of programming and the screening coordinator, with the coordinator responsible for deletion confirmation.
- On our side, the designated streaming administrator has immediate authority to disable the three accounts. We will name a primary administrator and a backup contact, with direct emails, before delivery. On withdrawal notice, we will disable the accounts immediately and expect the festival to confirm revocation the same business day after verification. If revocation is delayed, we will alert you at once and coordinate an access hold; the cut remains withdrawn until we confirm in writing that access is fully cut and offline copies are deleted.

**6. Embargo trigger and interaction with selection/catalog**
- The public release embargo governs all copying and disclosure until it lifts. Selection announcement does not waive secrecy for the ending or the cast cameo, and it does not auto-authorize any excerpt beyond what we approve in writing.
- If we withdraw the cut after selection announcement but before public release, the festival must pause any further circulation of the synopsis and catalog draft and halt any public-facing use until we confirm. Catalog publication may proceed only after we have signed off on the exact text and the selection has been announced; if withdrawal occurs before publication goes live, publication must stop until we re-clear or lift the embargo.
- All publicity excerpts, including any catalog text, remain subject to our prior approval. No adaptation, paraphrase, clip, still, or quotation may appear publicly without separate written approval.

**7. Board and catalog terms**
- Synopsis submitted for written approval, read verbatim in the confidential board meeting, with no screener, clips, or stills to the board: accepted.
- Text-only catalog drafting and internal circulation under confidentiality, omitting ending and cameo: accepted.
- Two business days for each review, with express written clearance required before use: accepted.
- Publication only after we sign off on the exact text and the festival has announced selection: accepted, subject to the withdrawal pause above.

**8. Pre-delivery items we need before we release the cut**
- Written confirmation of the streaming watermarking behavior (persistent viewer name through pause/snapshot).
- Written confirmation of the offline burning method and that playback cannot strip the watermark.
- Written certification from the transfer service covering erase-on-receipt, no backup retention, and immediate purge of unclaimed transfers on withdrawal.
- Written confirmation that the streaming service retains no content copies/backups beyond the active session and can purge pending artifacts on withdrawal.
- The reviewer list with names and affiliations, the two offline recipients, and confirmation that all five have signed confidentiality, no-forwarding, and no-further-copying terms.
- The designated festival contacts (head of programming and screening coordinator) with direct email addresses.
- The deletion record template and the device identifier format you will use.
- The draft synopsis and, if already prepared, the catalog entry for approval.
- Our primary and backup streaming administrator contacts for immediate disablement.

Once those items are received and the technical controls are verified, we will clear the review materials and proceed with delivery under the terms above. Any later change to reviewers, delivery method, watermarking, retention, or contact points must come back to us for prior approval before implementation.

We accept the deletion, withdrawal, board, and catalog terms. Delivery is pending. Two implementation details need agreement before either side handles the cut.

**Streaming control.** Our proposal was for your side to host the three individual streams. Your reply assigns hosting to the festival and immediate disablement to your administrators. Can you host the streams and give your primary and backup administrators direct authority to disable all three accounts? If festival hosting is essential, we would first need to identify a service that gives your administrators that authority. Our usual platform’s 30-day backup rules it out.

For either arrangement, the hosting party must obtain written confirmation from the service that viewers cannot disable their name watermark, that it remains visible on pause and in any available snapshot, and that the service retains no content copies, re-encodes, or backups beyond the active session. The service must identify any possible cached or pending artifacts and confirm how it will purge them immediately on withdrawal and verify completion. We will submit any residual retention for your written approval before delivery.

**Offline playback.** Burning the recipient’s name into every frame makes it part of the picture. A player can still crop or cover part of that picture. Would you accept written verification of the burn-in method and playback restricted to a designated player on each encrypted device, with cropping, zoom, and masking disabled? We would verify those controls on both devices with a test file first. We will also obtain the transfer service’s written certification of erasure on receipt, no backup retention, and immediate purge of unclaimed transfers on withdrawal. Any substitute requires your prior written approval.

**Deletion record template.** The coordinator will use one record for both files, with one row per recipient. Device IDs will be unique festival inventory references tied to the specific encrypted device. `FEST-001` illustrates the format.

| Recipient and affiliation | Device ID | Delivered filename, version and checksum | Deletion method | Temporary renders and caches cleared, with method | Completion date, time and zone | Recipient confirmation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Recipient 1] | [ID] | [File details] | [Method] | [Details] | [Timestamp] | [Confirmation] |
| [Recipient 2] | [ID] | [File details] | [Method] | [Details] | [Timestamp] | [Confirmation] |

The record will include the review-end or withdrawal timestamp and the screening coordinator’s name, signature, and signing time. The coordinator will return it within one business day. If either deletion is delayed, we will notify you immediately with a remediation plan and maintain the hold pending your written confirmation.

**Clearance and contacts.** Before delivery, we will provide the five names and affiliations, identify the two offline recipients, confirm all five signed the required terms, and supply direct emails for our head of programming and screening coordinator. Please provide the names and direct emails of your primary and backup streaming administrators. On withdrawal, we will immediately secure the offline devices, halt circulation and public-facing use, and confirm streaming revocation the same business day after verification. A withdrawal after announcement also stops scheduled publication and further use of already approved copy until written re-clearance.

Please supply a short synopsis you can clear for the board, or authorized source text from which we can draft one before viewing. We will read only the expressly cleared wording verbatim. If selected, we will draft the text-only catalog entry and submit it separately. Both texts will omit the ending and cameo. We will allow two business days for each review. Publication requires both the selection announcement and your written sign-off on the exact text.

We accept the deletion record template, the offline playback controls, and the board/catalog terms as written. Delivery remains pending until the two implementation details below are resolved and the required confirmations and contacts are exchanged.

**1. Hosting and streaming control**
We prefer to host the three individual streams on a service we control, so that our administrators have direct authority to disable all three accounts immediately on withdrawal. If we host, we will obtain and share with you written confirmation from the service that:
- viewers cannot disable the name watermark;
- the watermark remains visible throughout playback, including on pause and in any snapshot the player can produce;
- the service retains no content copies, re-encodes, or backups beyond the active viewing session;
- any cached, pending, or temporary artifacts are identified and can be purged immediately on our withdrawal instruction, with verification of completion.

We will provide the names and direct emails of a primary streaming administrator and a backup administrator before delivery, and both will have immediate disablement authority.

If we cannot meet those controls with our own service, we accept festival hosting only if the festival can identify a service that gives our administrators the same immediate disablement authority and that supplies the written confirmations listed above. In that case we need the service name, the admin-authority mechanism, and the written confirmation before we release the cut. Any residual retention the service proposes (for example, short technical logs or transient caches that contain no playable content) must be submitted to us for written approval before delivery. If the festival cannot meet that standard, we will not proceed with festival-hosted streams and will need a different delivery method agreed in advance.

Tradeoff: our hosting gives us the fastest withdrawal path and the clearest admin chain; festival hosting is acceptable only with equivalent controls and written proof. Please tell us which path you can support and provide the relevant service confirmation.

**2. Offline playback and watermarking**
We accept the offline approach as proposed, subject to verification:
- recipient name burned into every frame, with written confirmation of the burn-in method;
- playback restricted to a designated player on each encrypted device, with cropping, zoom, and masking disabled;
- a test file used first to verify those controls on both devices before the real cut is transferred;
- written certification from the transfer service covering erase-on-receipt, no backup retention, and immediate purge of unclaimed transfers on withdrawal.

If either device or the transfer service cannot meet those points, we require your written proposal for an equivalent control and our prior approval before use. We will review the test-file verification results and the transfer service certification before authorizing delivery.

**3. Deletion record**
The single-row-per-recipient template with device IDs as festival inventory references, plus the review-end/withdrawal timestamp and the coordinator’s name, signature, and signing time, is accepted. Please use that template and return the signed record within one business day of review completion or withdrawal. If either deletion is delayed, your immediate notice plus remediation plan and hold until we confirm in writing is accepted.

**4. Contacts and signed terms**
Before delivery we will need:
- the five names and affiliations, the two offline recipients, and written confirmation that all five have signed confidentiality, no-forwarding, and no-further-copying terms;
- direct emails for the head of programming and the screening coordinator;
- our primary and backup streaming administrator names and direct emails (we will supply these before delivery once the hosting path is fixed).

On withdrawal, we will disable the three streams immediately and expect the festival to confirm revocation the same business day after verification; any delay triggers immediate notice and a coordinated access hold.

**5. Synopsis for the board**
We will provide a short synopsis for board use that omits the ending and the cameo. To keep the board wording tight, we propose the following approach:
- We send you a draft synopsis of no more than about 120–150 words for our own approval; once we approve it, you may read that exact wording verbatim in the confidential board meeting.
- If your team prefers to draft from source text, we can supply a brief outline (premise, protagonist, central conflict, tone, and style) that also omits the ending and cameo. Any expansion from that outline must come back to us for approval before it is read to the board.
- We will allow two business days for each review and will give express written clearance before the wording is used.

If you want a synopsis now, we can prepare a draft for your review within two business days; alternatively, tell us the maximum length and the points you need covered and we will tailor it.

**6. Catalog wording**
We accept the catalog workflow: text-only drafting under confidentiality, submission to us for factual and secrecy review, two-business-day clearance, and publication only after both our written sign-off on the exact text and the festival’s selection announcement. The same no-ending/no-cameo rule applies, and any later change to the text requires our prior written approval.

**7. What we need before delivery**
- Confirmation of the hosting path (our service or a festival-identified service) and the corresponding written service confirmations described above.
- Written confirmation of the offline burn-in method, designated-player restrictions, disabled cropping/zoom/masking, and the test-file verification results.
- Written certification from the transfer service covering erasure-on-receipt, no backup retention, and immediate purge of unclaimed transfers on withdrawal.
- The reviewer list, affiliations, offline recipients, and signed terms for all five.
- Direct emails for the head of programming and screening coordinator.
- Our primary and backup streaming administrator names and direct emails (provided once the hosting path is fixed).
- The draft synopsis (or authorized outline) for board approval.

Once those items are received and the technical controls are verified, we will clear the review materials and proceed with delivery under the terms above. Any later change to hosting, watermarking, offline controls, reviewers, contacts, deletion process, or retention requires our prior written approval before implementation.

We accept your hosting of the three individual streams. Please send your service’s written confirmation covering the viewer-specific watermark during playback, pause, and snapshots, the agreed retention limits, and immediate, verifiable purge of temporary artifacts. Please include the names and direct emails of both administrators with authority to disable all three accounts. On withdrawal, the festival will verify revocation and confirm it to you the same business day.

For the board, please send your synopsis within two business days, with a maximum of 150 words. The premise, protagonist, central conflict, and a brief indication of tone or style will suffice. Please omit the ending and cameo and identify the exact version you clear in writing. A programmer will read that version verbatim in the confidential meeting.

Before delivery, the festival will provide:

- The names and affiliations of all five reviewers, identifying the two offline recipients, with confirmation that all five have signed the agreed terms.
- Direct emails for the head of programming and screening coordinator.
- Written confirmation of the per-frame name burn-in method and test-file results from each encrypted device, verifying that playback is restricted to the designated player with cropping, zoom, and masking disabled.
- The transfer service’s written certification that it erases each transfer on receipt, retains no backup, and immediately purges unclaimed transfers on withdrawal.

Delivery remains pending the contact exchange, technical verification, and your written clearance. If a control fails verification, we will submit any proposed substitute for your approval before use. Catalog clearance is separate and follows selection. Publication requires both the festival’s announcement and your written approval of the exact text, subject to any withdrawal hold.

We accept the split as framed. Delivery remains pending the items below; once they are in hand and verified, we will clear the review materials and proceed.

**1. Streaming hosting and administrator authority**
We will host the three individual streams. Before delivery we will provide:
- Written confirmation from our streaming service covering: a viewer-specific watermark that remains visible throughout playback, on pause, and in any snapshot the player can produce; retention limited to the active viewing session with no content copies, re-encodes, or persistent backups retained; and immediate, verifiable purge of any temporary, cached, or pending artifacts on our withdrawal instruction, with a completion confirmation step.
- The names and direct emails of the primary and backup streaming administrators, both of whom have immediate disablement authority over all three accounts.

On withdrawal, we will disable the accounts immediately. The festival will verify revocation and confirm it to us the same business day after verification. Any delayed revocation triggers immediate notice and a coordinated access hold until we confirm.

**2. Board synopsis**
We will deliver the synopsis within two business days, not exceeding 150 words. It will cover premise, protagonist, central conflict, and a brief tone/style indication, and will explicitly omit the ending and the cast cameo. We will identify the exact cleared version in writing (version number and date) so the programmer reads only that text verbatim in the confidential meeting. Any deviation from that version requires our prior written approval.

**3. Pre-delivery items we need from the festival**
Before we authorize delivery, please provide:
- Names and affiliations of all five reviewers, with the two offline recipients identified, and written confirmation that all five have signed the confidentiality, no-forwarding, and no-further-copying terms.
- Direct emails for the head of programming and the screening coordinator.
- Written confirmation of the per-frame name burn-in method, plus test-file results from each encrypted device showing playback restricted to the designated player with cropping, zoom, and masking disabled.
- The transfer service’s written certification that it erases each transfer on receipt, retains no backup, and immediately purges unclaimed transfers on withdrawal.

If any control fails verification, we will not proceed until we approve a substitute in writing. We will review the test-file results and the transfer certification before releasing the cut.

**4. Delivery trigger and withdrawal guard**
Once the above items are received and the streaming service confirmation is shared, we will clear the review materials and authorize delivery under the agreed terms. The no-copying/no-disclosure restriction remains in force until public release. Selection announcement does not lift secrecy for the ending or cameo and does not auto-authorize any excerpt. If we withdraw the cut at any point, the festival will immediately secure the offline devices, halt circulation and public-facing use, and confirm streaming revocation the same business day after verification; any delay triggers immediate notice and an access hold until we confirm. Catalog clearance remains separate and requires both the festival’s announcement and our written sign-off on the exact text, subject to any withdrawal hold.

**5. Next step**
Please confirm you will supply the five reviewer details, the signed-terms confirmation, the two contact emails, the burn-in/test-file verification, and the transfer service certification before we send the streaming confirmation and the synopsis. Once those arrive, we will issue the synopsis within two business days and proceed with delivery.

Confirmed. The festival will send its materials first. Our submission will include:

- Names and affiliations of all five reviewers, identifying the two offline recipients, and written confirmation that all five have signed the confidentiality, no-forwarding, and no-further-copying terms.
- Direct email addresses for the head of programming and the screening coordinator.
- The written method for burning each offline recipient’s name into every frame, plus test-file results for each encrypted device verifying that playback is restricted to the designated player with cropping, zoom, and masking disabled.
- The transfer service’s written certification of erasure on receipt, no backup retention, and immediate purge of unclaimed transfers on withdrawal.

After you receive those materials, we will await your streaming-service confirmation, both administrator contacts, and the versioned synopsis you will clear within two business days. Delivery of the cut remains subject to your written authorization after verification.

We note the submission plan and the sequence. The workflow is now fixed:

**1. Receipt and verification**
Upon receiving your package, we will verify:
- The five reviewer names and affiliations, the two offline recipients identified, and written confirmation that all five have signed the confidentiality, no-forwarding, and no-further-copying terms.
- Direct emails for the head of programming and the screening coordinator.
- The written per-frame burn-in method and the test-file results from each encrypted device confirming playback is restricted to the designated player with cropping, zoom, and masking disabled.
- The transfer service’s written certification covering erasure on receipt, no backup retention, and immediate purge of unclaimed transfers on withdrawal.

If any item is missing, incomplete, or fails verification, we will pause and request remediation before any authorization. Any proposed substitute control must come back to us for written approval before use.

**2. Our deliverables after verification**
Once the package passes verification, we will provide within two business days:
- Written confirmation from our streaming service covering the viewer-specific watermark during playback, pause, and snapshots; the agreed retention limit (active session only, no content copies/re-encodes/backups); and immediate, verifiable purge of temporary or pending artifacts on withdrawal with a completion confirmation step.
- The names and direct emails of the primary and backup streaming administrators with immediate disablement authority over all three accounts.
- The versioned synopsis (clearly versioned and dated), no more than 150 words, covering premise, protagonist, central conflict, and a brief tone/style indication, explicitly omitting the ending and the cameo. Only that exact text will be read verbatim by the programmer in the confidential board meeting.

**3. Delivery authorization**
We will issue written authorization to release the cut only after verification is complete and all of the above are in hand. Delivery remains subject to that authorization. The no-copying/no-disclosure restriction stays in force until public release. Selection announcement does not lift secrecy for the ending or cameo and does not auto-authorize any excerpt. Withdrawal at any time follows the agreed notice, device-hold, circulation-halt, and same-business-day revocation confirmation steps, with an access hold if revocation is delayed.

**4. Submission logistics**
To keep verification tight, please send the package to a single designated contact on your side and note which file or email carries the signed-terms confirmation, the burn-in method, the test-file results, and the transfer certification. We will acknowledge receipt and state when verification is complete and the release authorization is issued.

We are ready to proceed on receipt of your materials.

The screening coordinator will be the festival’s single point of contact. They will send one submission email with an attachment index. The email will list the five reviewers and their affiliations, identify the two offline recipients, confirm that all five signed the agreed terms, and give both festival contact emails.

The index will identify three attachments by filename: the burn-in method, the test-file results labeled by device ID, and the transfer service’s written certification. Please send verification questions and written release authorization to the coordinator on that thread.

We accept the submission workflow as described. The screening coordinator will be our single point of contact for this exchange.

**Upon receipt of the submission email and attachments, we will:**
- Verify the five reviewer names and affiliations, the two offline recipients identified, and the written confirmation that all five signed the confidentiality, no-forwarding, and no-further-copying terms.
- Verify the direct emails for the head of programming and the screening coordinator.

- The versioned synopsis (versioned and dated, no more than 150 words, omitting the ending and cameo) for verbatim board use.
- Written release authorization for delivery of the cut.

If any item is missing, unclear, or fails verification, we will request remediation on that thread and will not authorize delivery until the issue is resolved or a substitute control is approved in writing.

We are ready to receive the submission on that thread.
